            updateSpawnSelectBanner(payload.名称);
            window.parent?.postMessage({ channel: SPAWN_CHANNEL, type: 'solaris_spawn_selected', spawn: payload }, '*');
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (IS_SPAWN_SELECT_MODE) updateSpawnSelectBanner('');

      // ============ COORDINATE HELPERS ============
      function worldToScreen(wx, wy) {
        const cx = window.innerWidth / 2;
        const cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
        return {
          x: cx + (wx * SPREAD + viewX) * scale,
          y: cy + (wy * SPREAD + viewY) * scale
        };
      }

      function buildEdgePath(edge, src, tgt) {
        const s = worldToScreen(src.x, src.y);
        const t = worldToScreen(tgt.x, tgt.y);
        const curve = Number(edge.curve || 0);
        if (!Number.isFinite(curve) || Math.abs(curve) < 0.001) {
          return { s, t, c: null, curved: false };
        }

        const dx = t.x - s.x;
        const dy = t.y - s.y;
        const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        return {
          s,
          t,
          curved: true,
          c: {
            x: (s.x + t.x) / 2 + (-dy / len) * len * curve,
            y: (s.y + t.y) / 2 + (dx / len) * len * curve,
          }
        };
      }

      function edgePathPoint(path, u = 0.5) {
        if (!path.curved || !path.c) {
          return {
            x: path.s.x + (path.t.x - path.s.x) * u,
            y: path.s.y + (path.t.y - path.s.y) * u,
          };
        }
        const a = (1 - u) * (1 - u);
        const b = 2 * (1 - u) * u;
        const c = u * u;
        return {
          x: a * path.s.x + b * path.c.x + c * path.t.x,
          y: a * path.s.y + b * path.c.y + c * path.t.y,
        };
      }

      function edgePathTangent(path, u = 0.5) {
        if (!path.curved || !path.c) {
          return { x: path.t.x - path.s.x, y: path.t.y - path.s.y };
        }
        return {
          x: 2 * (1 - u) * (path.c.x - path.s.x) + 2 * u * (path.t.x - path.c.x),
          y: 2 * (1 - u) * (path.c.y - path.s.y) + 2 * u * (path.t.y - path.c.y),
        };
      }

      // ============ RESIZE ============
      function resizeCanvas() {
        const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = window.innerWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = window.innerHeight * dpr;
        canvas.style.width = window.innerWidth + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = window.innerHeight + 'px';
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        minimap.width = 168 * dpr;
        minimap.height = 128 * dpr;
        render();
      }
      window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

      // ============ RENDER EDGES ============
      function renderEdges() {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';

        function getEdgeStyle(edge) {
          if (edge.type === 'special') {
            return {
              strokeStyle: edge.curve ? 'rgba(178,63,206,0.55)' : 'rgba(178,63,206,0.5)',
              lineWidth: edge.curve ? 1.7 : 2.0,
              dash: edge.curve ? [3, 8] : [4, 6],
              labelColor: '#9a2fbf',
              labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
              labelBorder: 'rgba(178,63,206,0.35)'
            };
          }
          if (edge.type === 'gateway') {
            return {
              strokeStyle: edge.curve ? 'rgba(47,127,214,0.5)' : 'rgba(178,63,206,0.42)',
              lineWidth: edge.curve ? 1.6 : 1.8,
              dash: edge.curve ? [2, 8] : [2, 8],
              labelColor: edge.curve ? '#2f6bb0' : '#9a2fbf',
              labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
              labelBorder: edge.curve ? 'rgba(47,127,214,0.3)' : 'rgba(178,63,206,0.3)'
            };
          }
          if (edge.type === 'scene') {
            return {
              strokeStyle: 'rgba(120,140,170,0.42)',
              lineWidth: 1.1,
              dash: [2, 6],
              labelColor: '#7186a0',
              labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)',
              labelBorder: 'rgba(120,145,180,0.28)'
            };
          }
          if (edge.type === 'route') {
            // cross-region proximity link — a touch stronger than local roads
            return {
              strokeStyle: 'rgba(90,120,158,0.5)',
              lineWidth: 1.5,
              dash: [7, 6],
              labelColor: '#3c4c62',
              labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
              labelBorder: 'rgba(120,145,180,0.28)'
            };
          }
          // default local road (type 'road' / 'regional-mst' / legacy)
          return {
            strokeStyle: 'rgba(96,120,150,0.42)',
            lineWidth: 1.35,
            dash: [6, 7],
            labelColor: '#4a5c74',
            labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
            labelBorder: 'rgba(120,145,180,0.28)'
          };
        }

        edges.forEach(e => {
          if (e.type === 'scene' && scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE) return;
          const src = nodeMap[e.source];
          const tgt = nodeMap[e.target];
          if (!src || !tgt) return;
          if (scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE && (src.type === 'scene' || tgt.type === 'scene')) return;
          const style = getEdgeStyle(e);
          ctx.strokeStyle = style.strokeStyle;
          ctx.lineWidth = style.lineWidth * Math.max(0.6, scale);
          ctx.setLineDash(style.dash.map(v => v * Math.max(0.7, scale)));
          const path = buildEdgePath(e, src, tgt);
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(path.s.x, path.s.y);
          if (path.curved) ctx.quadraticCurveTo(path.c.x, path.c.y, path.t.x, path.t.y);
          else ctx.lineTo(path.t.x, path.t.y);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
        ctx.restore();

        // Edge labels — avoid overlapping with node positions
        ctx.save();
        const labelFontSize = Math.max(10, Math.min(15, 11 * scale));
        ctx.font = `500 ${labelFontSize}px 'Noto Serif SC', serif`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

        // Collect node screen rects for collision detection
        function textVisualUnits(text) {
          return [...String(text || '')].reduce((sum, ch) => sum + (/[\x00-\x7F]/.test(ch) ? 0.55 : 1), 0);
        }

        const nodeRects = [];
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          if (n.type === 'scene' && scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE) return;
          const p = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y);
          const cfg = typeConfig[n.type] || typeConfig.poi;
          const nodeScale = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.5, scale));
          const labelWidth = textVisualUnits(n.name) * cfg.labelSize + (n.type === 'scene' ? 16 : 24);
          const hw = (Math.max(cfg.size, labelWidth) * 0.5 + 12) * nodeScale;
          const hh = (cfg.size * 0.5 + cfg.labelSize * 0.85 + 18) * nodeScale;
          nodeRects.push({ x: p.x - hw, y: p.y - hh, w: hw * 2, h: hh * 2 });
        });

        function rectsOverlap(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
          return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
        }

        edges.forEach(e => {
          if (e.type === 'scene' && scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE) return;
          const src = nodeMap[e.source];
          const tgt = nodeMap[e.target];
          if (!src || !tgt) return;
          if (scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE && (src.type === 'scene' || tgt.type === 'scene')) return;
          const style = getEdgeStyle(e);
          const path = buildEdgePath(e, src, tgt);
          const mid = edgePathPoint(path, 0.5);
          let mx = mid.x;
          let my = mid.y;
          if (scale < 0.92) return;
          const text = e.label || '';
          if (!text) return;
          const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
          const ph = Math.max(16, labelFontSize + 8);
          const pw = tw + 16;

          // Check overlap with any node and nudge if needed
          const tangent = edgePathTangent(path, 0.5);
          const dx = tangent.x;
          const dy = tangent.y;
          const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1;
          // Perpendicular direction
          const nx = -dy / len;
          const ny = dx / len;
          const nudgeStep = 18;
          let blocked = false;
          for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt++) {
            let overlaps = false;
            for (const nr of nodeRects) {
              if (rectsOverlap(mx - pw / 2, my - ph / 2, pw, ph, nr.x, nr.y, nr.w, nr.h)) {
                overlaps = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (!overlaps) break;
            // Alternate nudge direction: perpendicular, then along edge
            if (attempt % 2 === 0) {
              mx += nx * nudgeStep;
              my += ny * nudgeStep;
            } else {
              mx -= nx * nudgeStep * 2;
              my -= ny * nudgeStep * 2;
            }
            blocked = attempt === 5;
          }
          if (blocked) return;

          ctx.fillStyle = style.labelBackground || 'rgba(12,18,28,0.78)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(mx - pw / 2, my - ph / 2, pw, ph, 4);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = style.labelBorder || 'rgba(138,122,90,0.2)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = style.labelColor || '#c8b890';
          ctx.fillText(text, mx, my);
        });
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ============ RENDER NODES ============
      let nodeElements = [];
      function createNodeElements() {
        nodeLayer.innerHTML = '';
        nodeElements = [];
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          const cfg = typeConfig[n.type] || typeConfig.poi;
          const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
          wrapper.className = 'node-wrapper';
          wrapper.dataset.id = n.id;
          wrapper.dataset.type = n.type;wrapper.dataset.icon = n.iconType || n.type;
          wrapper.style.setProperty('--nc', TYPE_COLORS[n.iconType || n.type] || TYPE_COLORS.poi);
          if (['city', 'castle', 'campus', 'stronghold'].includes(n.type)) wrapper.dataset.tier = 'major';

          const iconSize = cfg.size;
          const iconDiv = document.createElement('div');
          iconDiv.className = 'node-icon';
          if (n.type === 'otherspace') {
            // ornate icon fills the whole footprint, no disc
            iconDiv.innerHTML = `<svg width="${iconSize}" height="${iconSize}" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><use href="#icon-${n.iconType || n.type}"/></svg>`;
          } else {
            iconDiv.style.width = iconSize + 'px';
            iconDiv.style.height = iconSize + 'px';
            const glyph = Math.round(iconSize * (n.type === 'scene' ? 0.77 : 0.66));
            iconDiv.innerHTML = `<svg width="${glyph}" height="${glyph}" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><use href="#icon-${n.iconType || n.type}"/></svg>`;
          }

          const label = document.createElement('div');
          label.className = 'node-label';
          label.style.fontSize = cfg.labelSize + 'px';
          if (n.type === 'scene') {
            label.style.padding = '1px 7px';
            label.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.82)';
            label.style.color = '#55637a';
            label.style.fontWeight = '500';
          }
          if (cfg.bold) label.style.fontWeight = '600';
          label.textContent = n.name;

          wrapper.appendChild(iconDiv);
          wrapper.appendChild(label);

          // ============ SPECIAL MARKERS ============
          if (IS_SPAWN_SELECT_MODE && n.id === 'city_hometown') {
            const markerBg = document.createElement('div');
            markerBg.className = 'special-marker-recommended';
            markerBg.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;';
            wrapper.insertBefore(markerBg, iconDiv);
            const badge = document.createElement('div');
            badge.className = 'special-badge-recommended';
            badge.textContent = '推荐出生点';
            wrapper.appendChild(badge);
          }
          if (n.independent) {
            const markerBg = document.createElement('div');
            markerBg.className = 'special-marker-layer3';
            markerBg.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;';
            wrapper.insertBefore(markerBg, iconDiv);
            const badge = document.createElement('div');
            badge.className = 'special-badge-layer3';
            badge.textContent = '◇ 独立异空间';
            wrapper.appendChild(badge);
          }

          if (n.id === 'otherspace_thriller_paradise') {
            const markerBg = document.createElement('div');
            markerBg.className = 'special-marker-worldscar';
            markerBg.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;';
            wrapper.insertBefore(markerBg, iconDiv);
            const badge = document.createElement('div');
            badge.className = 'special-badge-worldscar';
            badge.textContent = '◆ 来吧，参与这超越思维的游戏';
            wrapper.appendChild(badge);
          }

          // Tooltip events
          wrapper.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
            tooltip.style.display = 'block';
            document.getElementById('tt-name').textContent = n.fullName || n.name;
            document.getElementById('tt-type').textContent = cfg.label;
            document.getElementById('tt-summary').textContent = (n.brief || n.summary || '').replace(/\n/g, ' ').substring(0, 140);
          });
          wrapper.addEventListener('mousemove', (ev) => {
            tooltip.style.left = (ev.clientX + 14) + 'px';
            tooltip.style.top = (ev.clientY + 14) + 'px';
            const tr = tooltip.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (tr.right > window.innerWidth - 8) tooltip.style.left = (ev.clientX - tr.width - 10) + 'px';
            if (tr.bottom > window.innerHeight - 8) tooltip.style.top = (ev.clientY - tr.height - 10) + 'px';
          });
          wrapper.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            tooltip.style.display = 'none';
          });

          // Click to open detail OR drag node in edit mode
          wrapper.addEventListener('mousedown', (ev) => {
            clickStartX = ev.clientX;
            clickStartY = ev.clientY;
            if (editMode) {
              ev.stopPropagation();
              if (addEdgeMode) return;
              nodeDragging = n;
              nodeDragStartX = ev.clientX;
              nodeDragStartY = ev.clientY;
              nodeOrigX = n.x;
              nodeOrigY = n.y;
            }
          });
          wrapper.addEventListener('mouseup', (ev) => {
            const dx = Math.abs(ev.clientX - clickStartX);
            const dy = Math.abs(ev.clientY - clickStartY);

            if (editMode && addEdgeMode) {
              if (dx < 5 && dy < 5) {
                tooltip.style.display = 'none';
                handleEdgeAddNodeClick(n);
              }
              return;
            }

            if (nodeDragging === n) {
              nodeDragging = null;
              if (dx < 5 && dy < 5) return; // was just a click, no drag
              return; // finished dragging
            }
            if (dx < 5 && dy < 5 && !editMode) {
              tooltip.style.display = 'none';
              if (IS_SPAWN_SELECT_MODE) emitSpawnSelection(n);
              else openDetail(n);
            }
          });

          wrapper.classList.toggle('editing', editMode);
          wrapper.classList.toggle('edge-source', addEdgeMode && edgeAddSourceId === n.id);
          nodeLayer.appendChild(wrapper);
          nodeElements.push({ el: wrapper, node: n });
        });
      }

      function updateNodePositions() {
        nodeElements.forEach(({ el, node }) => {
          if (node.type === 'scene' && scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE) {
            el.style.display = 'none';
            return;
          }
          el.style.display = '';
          const pos = worldToScreen(node.x, node.y);
          el.style.left = pos.x + 'px';
          el.style.top = pos.y + 'px';
          el.style.transform = `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(${Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.5, scale))})`;
          const lbl = el.querySelector('.node-label');
          if (lbl) {
            if (node.type === 'scene') {
              lbl.style.opacity = scale < SCENE_LABEL_VISIBLE_SCALE ? '0' : scale < 1.25 ? '0.72' : '0.92';
            } else {
              lbl.style.opacity = scale < 0.35 ? '0' : scale < 0.55 ? '0.6' : '1';
            }
          }
        });
        resolveSceneLabelOverlaps();
      }

      function getPaddedRect(rect, pad) {
        return {
          left: rect.left - pad,
          top: rect.top - pad,
          right: rect.right + pad,
          bottom: rect.bottom + pad,
        };
      }

      function screenRectsOverlap(a, b) {
        return a.left < b.right && a.right > b.left && a.top < b.bottom && a.bottom > b.top;
      }

      function resolveSceneLabelOverlaps() {
        // 地点名优先级高于路网标签；子地点出现时不再被避让逻辑直接隐藏。
        return;
        const placedRects = [];
        const sceneLabels = [];

        nodeElements.forEach(({ el, node }) => {
          if (el.style.display === 'none') return;
          const label = el.querySelector('.node-label');
          if (!label) return;

          if (node.type === 'scene') {
            sceneLabels.push({ label, node });
            return;
          }

          if (label.style.opacity !== '0') {
            placedRects.push(getPaddedRect(label.getBoundingClientRect(), 8));
          }
        });

        sceneLabels.forEach(({ label }) => {
          if (scale < SCENE_LABEL_VISIBLE_SCALE) {
            label.style.opacity = '0';
            return;
          }

          const rect = getPaddedRect(label.getBoundingClientRect(), 6);
          const overlaps = placedRects.some(placed => screenRectsOverlap(rect, placed));
          if (overlaps) {
            label.style.opacity = '0';
            return;
          }

          label.style.opacity = scale < 1.7 ? '0.58' : '0.86';
          placedRects.push(rect);
        });
      }

      // ============ DETAIL MODAL ============
      function openDetail(node) {
        const cfg = typeConfig[node.iconType || node.type] || typeConfig.poi;
        const iconSize = 26;
        const dc = TYPE_COLORS[node.iconType || node.type] || TYPE_COLORS.poi;
        const briefText = typeof node.brief === 'string' ? node.brief.trim() : '';
        const summaryText = typeof node.summary === 'string' ? node.summary.trim() : '';

        // Header: icon + name + type badge
        detailHeader.innerHTML = `
    <div class="detail-title">
      <span style="width:46px;height:46px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:${dc};box-shadow:0 6px 16px -4px ${dc};color:#fff;">
        <svg width="${iconSize}" height="${iconSize}" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><use href="#icon-${node.iconType || node.type}"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span>${escHtml(node.name)}</span>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:6px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;">
      <span class="detail-type-badge" style="background:color-mix(in srgb, ${dc} 12%, #fff); color:${dc}; border-color:color-mix(in srgb, ${dc} 32%, #fff);">${cfg.label}</span>
      ${node.tier ? `<span class="detail-type-badge" style="background:rgba(90,120,160,0.1); color:#4a5c74; border-color:rgba(120,145,180,0.28);">${escHtml(node.tier)}</span>` : ''}
    </div>
  `;

        // Brief / Summary
        if (briefText) {
          detailSummary.textContent = briefText;
          detailSummary.style.display = '';
        } else if (summaryText) {
          detailSummary.textContent = summaryText;
          detailSummary.style.display = '';
        } else {
          detailSummary.style.display = 'none';
        }

        // Body
        let bodyHtml = '';

        function formatDetailText(str) {
          const normalized = String(str)
            .trim()
            .replace(/。；/g, '；')
            .replace(/；\s*；+/g, '；')
            .replace(/\s+；/g, '；')
            .replace(/；\s+/g, '；');
          if (!normalized) return '';

          const parts = normalized
            .split(/；(?=[^；：\n]{1,12}：)/)
            .map(part => part.trim())
            .filter(Boolean);
          const looksStructured = parts.length >= 2 && parts.every(part => /^[^；：\n]{1,12}：/.test(part));
          if (!looksStructured) return escHtml(normalized);

          return `<div class="detail-kv-list">${parts.map(part => {
            const idx = part.indexOf('：');
            const key = part.slice(0, idx).trim();
            const value = part.slice(idx + 1).trim().replace(/；$/g, '');
            return `<div class="detail-kv-row">
          <div class="detail-kv-key">${escHtml(key)}：</div>
          <div class="detail-kv-value">${escHtml(value)}</div>
        </div>`;
          }).join('')}</div>`;
        }

        if (briefText && summaryText && briefText !== summaryText) {
          bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-section-title">概述</div>
        <div class="detail-section-content">${formatDetailText(summaryText)}</div>
      </div>`;
        }

        // Physical Consequences grid
        if (node.physicalConsequences && typeof node.physicalConsequences === 'object') {
          const pc = node.physicalConsequences;
          // 过滤空值和无意义占位文本
          const TRIVIAL_RE = /^(因.*而异|正常|倒置|无$|无水|无水源|N\/A|未知|待定)/;
          const entries = Object.entries(pc).filter(([k, v]) => {
            if (!v) return false;
            const s = String(v).trim();
            if (!s) return false;
            if (TRIVIAL_RE.test(s)) return false;
            // 非 terrain 字段：过于简短的值（<=4字）没有信息量
            if (k !== 'terrain' && s.length <= 4) return false;
            return true;
          });
          if (entries.length > 0) {
            bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-section-title">环境</div>
        <div class="detail-grid">`;
            entries.forEach(([key, val]) => {
              const label = PHYSICAL_LABELS[key] || key;
              bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-grid-item">
          <div class="grid-label">${escHtml(label)}</div>
          <div class="grid-value">${escHtml(String(val))}</div>
        </div>`;
            });
            bodyHtml += `</div></div>`;
          }
        }

        // All other fields
        for (const [key, val] of getOrderedNodeEntries(node)) {
          if (SKIP_FIELDS.has(key)) continue;
          if (key === 'tier') continue; // already shown in header
          if (!FIELD_LABELS[key]) continue; // unknown field, skip
          if (val === null || val === undefined) continue;

          // Check emptiness
          if (Array.isArray(val)) {
            if (val.length === 0) continue;
            // Render as tags
            bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-section-title">${escHtml(FIELD_LABELS[key])}</div>
        <div class="detail-tags">`;
            val.forEach(item => {
              bodyHtml += `<span class="detail-tag">${escHtml(String(item))}</span>`;
            });
            bodyHtml += `</div></div>`;
          } else if (typeof val === 'object') {
            // Skip objects (physicalConsequences already handled)
            continue;
          } else {
            const strVal = String(val).trim();
            if (!strVal) continue;
            bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-section">
        <div class="detail-section-title">${escHtml(FIELD_LABELS[key])}</div>
        <div class="detail-section-content">${formatDetailText(strVal)}</div>
      </div>`;
          }
        }

        // Connected locations
        const connections = [];
        edges.forEach(e => {
          if (e.source === node.id && nodeMap[e.target]) {
            connections.push({ node: nodeMap[e.target], label: e.label, distance: e.distance });
          } else if (e.target === node.id && nodeMap[e.source]) {
            connections.push({ node: nodeMap[e.source], label: e.label, distance: e.distance });
          }
        });
        if (connections.length > 0) {
          bodyHtml += `<div class="detail-connections">

      // ============ MINIMAP ============
      function renderMinimap() {
        const dpr = devicePixelRatio;
        const mw = 168 * dpr, mh = 128 * dpr;
        minimapCtx.clearRect(0, 0, mw, mh);

        let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          if (n.type === 'scene') return;
          const wx = n.x * SPREAD, wy = n.y * SPREAD;
          if (wx < minX) minX = wx; if (wx > maxX) maxX = wx;
          if (wy < minY) minY = wy; if (wy > maxY) maxY = wy;
        });
        const pad = 100;
        minX -= pad; maxX += pad; minY -= pad; maxY += pad;
        const rangeX = maxX - minX, rangeY = maxY - minY;
        const mScale = Math.min(mw / rangeX, mh / rangeY) * 0.9;
        const offX = (mw - rangeX * mScale) / 2;
        const offY = (mh - rangeY * mScale) / 2;

        function miniPos(wx, wy) {
          return { x: offX + (wx - minX) * mScale, y: offY + (wy - minY) * mScale };
        }

        // Edges
        minimapCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(120,140,170,0.35)';
        minimapCtx.lineWidth = 0.6 * dpr;
        minimapCtx.setLineDash([]);
        edges.forEach(e => {
          if (e.type === 'scene') return;
          const src = nodeMap[e.source], tgt = nodeMap[e.target];
          if (!src || !tgt) return;
          if (scale < SCENE_VISIBLE_SCALE && (src.type === 'scene' || tgt.type === 'scene')) return;
          const s = miniPos(src.x * SPREAD, src.y * SPREAD);
          const t = miniPos(tgt.x * SPREAD, tgt.y * SPREAD);
          minimapCtx.beginPath();
          minimapCtx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
          minimapCtx.lineTo(t.x, t.y);
          minimapCtx.stroke();
        });

        // Nodes
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          if (n.type === 'scene') return;
          const p = miniPos(n.x * SPREAD, n.y * SPREAD);
          if (n.id === 'otherspace_thriller_paradise') {
            minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#dd7a2b';
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            minimapCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.5 * dpr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            minimapCtx.fill();
          } else if (n.independent) {
            minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#b23fce';
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            minimapCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.5 * dpr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            minimapCtx.fill();
          } else {
            minimapCtx.fillStyle = TYPE_COLORS[n.iconType || n.type] || '#6b7d94';
            minimapCtx.beginPath();
            minimapCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, (['city', 'campus', 'stronghold'].includes(n.type) ? 2.8 : 1.7) * dpr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            minimapCtx.fill();
          }
        });

        // Viewport rect
        const cx = window.innerWidth / 2, cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
        const vpLeft = (-viewX - cx / scale), vpTop = (-viewY - cy / scale);
        const vpRight = (-viewX + cx / scale), vpBottom = (-viewY + cy / scale);
        const tl = miniPos(vpLeft, vpTop);
        const br = miniPos(vpRight, vpBottom);
        minimapCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(47,127,214,0.85)';
        minimapCtx.lineWidth = 1.4 * dpr;
        minimapCtx.setLineDash([]);
        minimapCtx.strokeRect(tl.x, tl.y, br.x - tl.x, br.y - tl.y);
      }

      // ============ MAIN RENDER ============
      function render() {
        renderEdges();

      }

      // ============ PAN ============
      container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if (e.target.closest('.node-wrapper')) return;
        isDragging = true;
        dragStartX = e.clientX;
        dragStartY = e.clientY;
        dragViewX = viewX;
        dragViewY = viewY;
        container.classList.add('grabbing');
      });
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        // Node dragging in edit mode
        if (nodeDragging) {
          const dx = (e.clientX - nodeDragStartX) / scale / SPREAD;
          const dy = (e.clientY - nodeDragStartY) / scale / SPREAD;
          nodeDragging.x = nodeOrigX + dx;
          nodeDragging.y = nodeOrigY + dy;
          render();
          return;
        }
        if (!isDragging) return;
        viewX = dragViewX + (e.clientX - dragStartX) / scale;
        viewY = dragViewY + (e.clientY - dragStartY) / scale;
        render();
      });
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        if (nodeDragging) { nodeDragging = null; return; }
        isDragging = false;
        container.classList.remove('grabbing');
      });

      // ============ ZOOM ============
      container.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const zoomFactor = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;
        const cx = window.innerWidth / 2;
        const cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
        const wx = (e.clientX - cx) / scale - viewX;
        const wy = (e.clientY - cy) / scale - viewY;
        scale *= zoomFactor;
        scale = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(3, scale));
        viewX = (e.clientX - cx) / scale - wx;
        viewY = (e.clientY - cy) / scale - wy;
        render();
      }, { passive: false });

      function zoomIn() { scale = Math.min(3, scale * 1.2); render(); }
      function zoomOut() { scale = Math.max(0.15, scale / 1.2); render(); }
      function resetView() {
        if (lastMatchedNodeId && nodeMap[lastMatchedNodeId]) {
          const n = nodeMap[lastMatchedNodeId];
          viewX = -n.x * SPREAD;
          viewY = -n.y * SPREAD;
        } else {
          viewX = 0; viewY = 0;
        }
        scale = 0.65; render();
      }
      window.zoomIn = zoomIn; window.zoomOut = zoomOut; window.resetView = resetView;

      // ============ TOUCH SUPPORT ============
      let lastTouchDist = 0;
      let lastTouchCenter = null;
      container.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        if (e.touches.length === 1) {
          isDragging = true;
          dragStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
          dragStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
          dragViewX = viewX;
          dragViewY = viewY;
        } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
          isDragging = false;
          const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
          const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
          lastTouchDist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          lastTouchCenter = {
            x: (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2,
            y: (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2
          };
        }
      }, { passive: true });
      container.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) {
          viewX = dragViewX + (e.touches[0].clientX - dragStartX) / scale;
          viewY = dragViewY + (e.touches[0].clientY - dragStartY) / scale;
          render();
        } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
          const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
          const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
          if (lastTouchDist > 0) {
            const zoomFactor = dist / lastTouchDist;
            const cx = window.innerWidth / 2;
            const cy = window.innerHeight / 2;
            const tcx = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
            const tcy = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
            const wx = (tcx - cx) / scale - viewX;
            const wy = (tcy - cy) / scale - viewY;
            scale *= zoomFactor;
            scale = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(3, scale));
            viewX = (tcx - cx) / scale - wx;
            viewY = (tcy - cy) / scale - wy;
            render();
          }
          lastTouchDist = dist;
        }
      }, { passive: false });
      container.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
        isDragging = false;
        lastTouchDist = 0;
        lastTouchCenter = null;
      });

      // ============ EDIT MODE ============
      function updateEdgePickHighlight() {
        nodeElements.forEach(({ el, node }) => {

      function updateEditHint() {
        const hint = document.getElementById('edit-hint');
        if (!hint) return;
        if (!editMode) {
          hint.textContent = '';
          return;
        }
        if (addEdgeMode) {
          if (edgeAddSourceId && nodeMap[edgeAddSourceId]) {
            hint.textContent = `已选起点：${nodeMap[edgeAddSourceId].name}，点击目标节点创建连线`;
          } else {
            hint.textContent = '点击一个节点作为起点，再点击另一个节点作为终点';
          }
          return;
        }
        if (deleteEdgeMode) {
          hint.textContent = '点击连线中间的 × 删除';
          return;
        }
        hint.textContent = '拖拽节点调整位置';
      }

      function edgeExists(a, b) {
        return edges.some(e => (
          (e.source === a && e.target === b) ||
          (e.source === b && e.target === a)
        ));
      }

      function handleEdgeAddNodeClick(node) {
        if (!editMode || !addEdgeMode) return;
        const hint = document.getElementById('edit-hint');

        if (!edgeAddSourceId) {
          edgeAddSourceId = node.id;
          updateEdgePickHighlight();
          updateEditHint();
          return;
        }

        if (edgeAddSourceId === node.id) {
          edgeAddSourceId = null;
          updateEdgePickHighlight();
          updateEditHint();
          return;
        }

        const sourceId = edgeAddSourceId;
        const targetId = node.id;
        const srcName = nodeMap[sourceId]?.name || sourceId;
        const tgtName = nodeMap[targetId]?.name || targetId;

        if (edgeExists(sourceId, targetId)) {
          edgeAddSourceId = targetId;
          updateEdgePickHighlight();
          hint.textContent = `连线已存在：${srcName} ↔ ${tgtName}，已切换起点`;
          setTimeout(() => {
            if (editMode && addEdgeMode) updateEditHint();
          }, 1500);
          return;
        }

        let label = window.prompt('请输入连线标签（可留空）', '');
        if (label === null) label = '';
        label = label.trim();

        edges.push({ source: sourceId, target: targetId, label });
        edgeAddSourceId = targetId;
        updateEdgePickHighlight();
        render();

        hint.textContent = `已添加连线：${srcName} → ${tgtName}`;
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (editMode && addEdgeMode) updateEditHint();
        }, 1500);
      }

      const region=locateRegion(name);if(region)return region;
    }
    for(const {map,index} of maps) if([map.root,map.name].some(name => keys(name).some(key => candidates.includes(key)))) return {mapIndex:index,point:null,regionName:map.root || map.name,precision:'region',matchedName:map.root || map.name};
  }
  return null;
}

      function solarisFindLocation(place,area,continent,layer){
        const data={maps:SOLARIS_META.maps.map((map,i)=>({...map,points:window.__SOLARIS_LAYERS__[i].mapData.nodes})),regions:SOLARIS_META.regions};
        const hit=resolveSolarisMapLocation(data,{场所:place,区域:area,大陆:continent},layer);
        return hit?{i:hit.mapIndex,node:hit.point,precision:hit.precision,regionName:hit.regionName}:null;
      }
      function findMatchingNode(place,area,continent){
        const hit=solarisFindLocation(place,area,continent,currentLayerIndex);
        const node=hit?.node?(nodeMap[hit.node.id]||nodes.find(n=>n.id===hit.node.id)||null):null;
        return node?{...node,solarisLocationPrecision:hit.precision}:null;
      }
            async function solarisApplyState(data){
        _mvuLocation=data?.世界信息?.位置||{};document.getElementById('solaris-loc').textContent='当前位置：'+[_mvuLocation.区域,_mvuLocation.场所].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
        let match;const ordered=SOLARIS_META.maps.map((m,i)=>({m,i})).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.m.id==='unified')-Number(a.m.id==='unified'));
        match=solarisFindLocation(_mvuLocation.场所,_mvuLocation.区域,_mvuLocation.大陆);
        if(!match){for(const term of [_mvuLocation.区域,_mvuLocation.场所].filter(Boolean)){const i=SOLARIS_META.maps.findIndex(m=>m.name===term||m.root===term);if(i>=0){match={i};break;}}}
        if(match&&match.i!==currentLayerIndex)await solarisSwitch(match.i);updatePlayerLocation();
      }
      window.SOLARIS_CREATION_MAP={switch:solarisSwitch,fit:solarisFit,applyState:solarisApplyState,getState:()=>({layer:currentLayerIndex,name:SOLARIS_META.maps[currentLayerIndex].name,nodes:nodes.length})};
      setTimeout(solarisFit,50);


      // ============ MVU 接入层 — 通过 postMessage 接收位置数据 ============
      // map.html 作为跨域 iframe 嵌入在底部状态栏中，无法直接访问 Mvu
      // 由底部状态栏通过 postMessage 推送位置数据

      let _mvuLocation = { 场所: '', 区域: '', 大陆: '' };

      // 玩家位置标记 — 直接附加到匹配节点的 wrapper 上（同入口标记方式）
      let lastMatchedNodeId = null;

      function removePlayerMarker() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.special-marker-player, .special-badge-player').forEach(el => el.remove());
      }

      function updatePlayerLocation() {
        const 场所 = _mvuLocation.场所 || '';
        const 区域 = _mvuLocation.区域 || '';
        const 大陆 = _mvuLocation.大陆 || '';

        if (!场所 && !区域 && !大陆) {
          removePlayerMarker();
          lastMatchedNodeId = null;
          return;
        }

        const matchedNode = findMatchingNode(场所, 区域, 大陆);

        if (!matchedNode) {
          removePlayerMarker();
          lastMatchedNodeId = null;
          return;
        }

        const displayName = 场所 || 区域 || matchedNode.name;
        const badgeText = matchedNode.solarisLocationPrecision==='node' ? `📍 ${displayName}`
          : matchedNode.solarisLocationPrecision==='nearby' ? `📍 附近定位：${displayName}` : `📍 区域定位：${matchedNode.name}（${displayName}）`;
        const existingBadge=document.querySelector('.special-badge-player');
        if(lastMatchedNodeId===matchedNode.id && existingBadge){existingBadge.textContent=badgeText;return;}

        // 移除旧标记
        removePlayerMarker();
        lastMatchedNodeId = matchedNode.id;

        // 找到对应的 node-wrapper
        const wrapper = nodeLayer.querySelector(`.node-wrapper[data-id="${matchedNode.id}"]`);
        if (!wrapper) return;

        // 插入标记背景（同入口标记方式）
        const markerBg = document.createElement('div');
        markerBg.className = 'special-marker-player';
        markerBg.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;';
        const iconDiv = wrapper.querySelector('.node-icon');
        if (iconDiv) wrapper.insertBefore(markerBg, iconDiv);
        else wrapper.prepend(markerBg);

        // 插入标签
        const badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.className = 'special-badge-player';
        badge.textContent = badgeText;
        wrapper.appendChild(badge);
      }

      function normalizeStr(s) {
        // Normalize width, hierarchy separators, and whitespace.
        return String(s || '')
          .normalize('NFKC')
          .replace(/[\u30fb\u2027\u2022\uFF0F\/\\>|]+/g, '\u00b7')
          .replace(/\s*\.\s*/g, '\u00b7')
          .replace(/\s*\u00b7\s*/g, '\u00b7')
          .replace(/\s+/g, '')
          .replace(/\u00b7+/g, '\u00b7')
          .replace(/^\u00b7|\u00b7$/g, '')
          .toLowerCase();
      }

      function getLocationParts(value) {
        const normalized = normalizeStr(value);
        if (!normalized) return [];
        // Match the most specific, rightmost segment first.
        // Example: country > province > city => city, province, country.
        return normalized.split('\u00b7').filter(Boolean).reverse();
      }

      function getNodeSearchNames(node) {
        return [node.name, node.displayName, node.fullName]
          .map(normalizeStr)
          .filter(Boolean);
      }

      function findMatchingNodeLegacy(place, area, continent) {
        const rawCandidates = [place, area, continent]
          .map(value => String(value || '').trim())
          .filter(Boolean);
        if (!rawCandidates.length) return null;

        const nodeNames = nodes.map(node => ({ node, names: getNodeSearchNames(node) }));

        // 1. Exact match against direct node names and aliases.
        for (const value of rawCandidates) {
          const normalized = normalizeStr(value);
          const exact = nodeNames.find(item => item.names.includes(normalized));
          if (exact) return exact.node;
        }

        // 2. Parse hierarchical values from the rightmost (most specific) part.
        // This makes "China \u00b7 Nanjing" resolve to the Nanjing node.
        for (const value of rawCandidates) {
          for (const part of getLocationParts(value)) {
            if (part.length < 2) continue;
            const exactPart = nodeNames.find(item => item.names.includes(part));
            if (exactPart) return exactPart.node;
          }
        }

        // 3. Fall back to containment matching, longest term first.
        const fuzzyTerms = rawCandidates
          .flatMap(getLocationParts)
          .concat(rawCandidates.map(normalizeStr))
          .filter(term => term.length >= 2)
          .filter((term, index, list) => list.indexOf(term) === index)
          .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);

        for (const term of fuzzyTerms) {
          const fuzzy = nodeNames.find(item => item.names.some(name => (
            name.includes(term) || term.includes(name)
          )));
          if (fuzzy) return fuzzy.node;
        }
        return null;
      }

      // Receive location updates through postMessage.
      window.addEventListener('message', async (e) => {
        if(e.source!==window.parent)return;
        if(e.data?.type==='solaris_map_state'){ await solarisApplyState(e.data.stat_data||{});return;}
        if (e.data && e.data.type === 'mvu_location' && e.data.位置) {
          await solarisApplyState({世界信息:{位置:e.data.位置}});
          return;
        }
        if (e.data && (e.data.type === 'dragon_spawn_focus' || e.data.type === 'amber_spawn_focus') && e.data.spawn) {
          const spawn = e.data.spawn || {};
          const nextLayer = Number.isFinite(Number(spawn.地图层级)) ? Number(spawn.地图层级) : currentLayerIndex;
          if (nextLayer !== currentLayerIndex) {
            await switchLayer(nextLayer);
          }
          _mvuLocation = {
            大陆: spawn.大陆 || getLayerDisplayName(nextLayer),
            区域: spawn.区域 || spawn.层级 || '',
            场所: spawn.场所 || spawn.名称 || ''
          };
          updateSpawnSelectBanner(spawn.名称 || spawn.场所 || '');
          updatePlayerLocation();
        }
      });

      // 通知宿主本页已就绪：mvu 位置宿主（底部状态栏）用无 channel 版；
      // 出生点宿主（开局页）用带 channel 版，并带上当前模式。
      try {
        window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'solaris_map_ready' }, '*');
      } catch (e) { }
      try {
        window.parent.postMessage({
          channel: SPAWN_CHANNEL,
          type: 'map_ready',
          mode: MAP_MODE
        }, '*');
      } catch (e) { }

      // 在 minimap 中也绘制玩家位置
      const _origRenderMinimap = renderMinimap;
      renderMinimap = function () {
        _origRenderMinimap();
        if (!lastMatchedNodeId) return;
        const node = nodeMap[lastMatchedNodeId];
        if (!node) return;
        // 复用 minimap 坐标系
        const dpr = devicePixelRatio;
        const mw = 168 * dpr, mh = 128 * dpr;
        let minX = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
        nodes.forEach(n => {
          const wx = n.x * SPREAD, wy = n.y * SPREAD;
          if (wx < minX) minX = wx; if (wx > maxX) maxX = wx;
          if (wy < minY) minY = wy; if (wy > maxY) maxY = wy;
        });
        const pad = 100;
        minX -= pad; maxX += pad; minY -= pad; maxY += pad;
        const rangeX = maxX - minX, rangeY = maxY - minY;
        const mScale = Math.min(mw / rangeX, mh / rangeY) * 0.9;
        const offX = (mw - rangeX * mScale) / 2;
        const offY = (mh - rangeY * mScale) / 2;
        const px = offX + (node.x * SPREAD - minX) * mScale;
        const py = offY + (node.y * SPREAD - minY) * mScale;
        // 绘制绿色玩家点
        minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#00dc82';
        minimapCtx.beginPath();
        minimapCtx.arc(px, py, 4 * dpr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        minimapCtx.fill();
        minimapCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,220,130,0.5)';
        minimapCtx.lineWidth = 1.5 * dpr;
        minimapCtx.beginPath();
        minimapCtx.arc(px, py, 6 * dpr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        minimapCtx.stroke();
      };

      // ============ INIT ============
      createNodeElements();
      buildLegend();
      resizeCanvas();
    })(); // end async init
  </script>
</body>

</html>

"

"<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>索拉里斯 · 创世回廊地图</title>
  
  <script>window.__SOLARIS_LAYERS__=[{"mapData":{"title":"索拉里斯总图","nodes":[{"id":"jinzhou-0","name":"北落野","type":"zone","iconType":"zone","parentName":"","x":276,"y":-223,"brief":"今州北部与残象潮、天悬烽火战事密切相关的区域。主线在北落峡谷、悬浮废墟等地点展开战斗与突入；局部异常、敌人和通路随实际战况变化。","地点资料":"北落峡谷：北落野的峡谷地点。主线突入、炮火支援和沿途战斗涉及不同位置，不将峡谷、远望营地和凿空炮台直接视为同一个地点。\n\n悬浮废墟：北落野腹地标志性景观。旧日城池残骸在紊乱频率作用下脱离地面，层层悬浮交错，黑石顺着断壁蔓延，残痕里留存鸣式战争的遗迹。废墟内部通道错综复杂，大量高阶残象盘踞其中，可见不同危险度的残象活动，具体敌人与鸣式相关事件按当前主线处理。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-1","name":"荒石高地","type":"plains","iconType":"plains","parentName":"","x":164,"y":-130,"brief":"今州的荒野区域，地图标有远望营地、凋零防线、止戈关峡和伏波阵前等地点。军营、道路与残象活动分别按所在地点及当前战况描写。","地点资料":"远望营地：荒石高地的营地地点。营地警戒、补给与在场人员依当时战况展开，与北落野内的峡谷、炮台分别定位。\n\n止戈关峡：荒石高地的峡谷地点，崖壁、岩石和通路形成沿途地形。当前巡防、聚居者与敌对遭遇分别由现场确认。\n\n凋零防线：荒石高地的地图地点，与附近的巡防及残象威胁相关。具体敌人名称、危险度和数量依当前任务及现场确定。\n\n伏波阵前：荒石高地的前沿整备地，简易掩体沿坡布设，巡防队在此清点装备、观察前路，夜里只留遮光的值守灯。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-2","name":"云陵谷","type":"mountain","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"","x":24,"y":-60,"brief":"云陵谷是瑝珑属下今州城的边地野外。《万象新声·上》中，漂泊者在这里苏醒，与秧秧、炽霞相识；白芷已分头调查附近正在形成的无音区。开场只确定在云陵谷，不固定为谷内某个地图地点。","地点资料":"谷口（场景描述）：谷地出入口的普通场景描述，具体位置和通行路线随实际行进确认，未提供独立地图坐标。\n\n鸣钟涧：云陵谷内的地图地点，与云陵谷整体分别标记。本卡《万象新声》开场落点不固定在这里。\n\n玉龙台：云陵谷的小区域，也是《万象新声》初期探索路线涉及的地点。可用于表现漂泊者初到今州时的山野探索，不将其写成另一座城市。\n\n夜明坡：云陵谷的小区域，与鸣钟涧、玉龙台共同组成游戏开篇的探索地带。它是野外地点，和今州城内街区分开。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-3","name":"中曲台地","type":"plains","iconType":"plains","parentName":"","x":131,"y":-51,"brief":"今州境内的台地与村落区域，地图标有潮生崖、桃源乡、祈池村、谷北地和原点科考站等地点。祈池村的调查、村民处境与残星会活动由相应主线逐步交付。","地点资料":"潮生崖：中曲台地的临水崖地，可从崖壁、岸线和沿途观景点描写环境。景观不预设某些敌人或宝藏必然在场。\n\n原点科考站：中曲台地的科考设施地点，科研活动、人员与设备状态依现场和任务呈现。\n\n桃源乡：中曲台地的聚落地点，村落、道路和周边林地分别构成当地场景。居民处境与沿途遭遇依实际行程展开。\n\n萤泊海：水草繁密的浅水地，暮色中细小荧光沿水面浮动，远望如星屑泊入湖海，夜行时容易误判岸线。\n\n撷华庄：今州近郊、中曲台地探索路线中的地点，周围分布可捕鱼的池塘。适合描写城郊水域与野外行走，不能据地名认定为某个角色的私人庄园。\n\n龙望郊：今州主城附近的郊野地点，中曲台地探索路线涉及此处，附近可见池塘水域。它和主城、撷华庄分别标注。\n\n叠石坪：层层裸岩铺成的开阔台地，石缝间长着矮草。旧路在此分岔，风化石堆常被旅人当作辨路标记。\n\n祈池村：中曲台地的村落，是今州早期主线调查涉及的地点。已有剧情文本明确其所在区域；不沿用旧资料将其并入怨鸟泽的说法。村落现状随当前章节呈现。\n\n谷北地：中曲台地北侧的地图地点。实地收集路线将它与桃源乡一并探索，但两者各有地名，应保留为两个节点。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-4","name":"今州","type":"city","iconType":"city","parentName":"","x":153,"y":-12,"brief":"瑝珑的边塞州城，城内有边庭、研究机构、广场与居民生活街巷，城后为屏庭山。令尹、巡尉、研究人员与夜归军承担不同职责；城防、对外通行与庆典气氛随当前主线和实际时间变化。","地点资料":"边庭：全文中出现的地点或设施，具体用途以当前任务为准。\n\n屏庭山：今州城的后山。任务全文中，秧秧说明可从今州城广场后的瀑布穿过去，沿花朵指引前往山中寻找维里奈。具体行进方向按当前路线描述。\n\n今州城界：库街区地图对今州主城的地点标注。本卡将“今州”“今州城”“今州城界”作为同一主城范围的定位用语，不另造一座同名城池。\n\n倚湖丘：临近今州湖岸的缓丘，草坡与石阶交错，是居民散步、旅人入城前整理行装的歇脚处。\n\n今州城广场：全文中的城内广场，可由广场后的瀑布前往后山。\n\n商业街巷（场景描述）：城内店铺、食肆与居民往来的日常场景，不额外指定固定行政片区。","detailMap":"","aliases":["今州城","今州州城"]},{"id":"jinzhou-5","name":"虎口山脉","type":"mountain","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"","x":165,"y":59,"brief":"今州的山地与矿业活动区域，地图标有虎口矿场、泷垂川和集散中心。矿区作业、山间通路及地下遭遇各有具体位置，不把归墟港市的落定岭归入本区。","地点资料":"虎口矿场：虎口山脉的矿业活动地点，矿坑、作业设施与工人生活构成场景。具体矿种、开采状态和地下风险依任务确认。\n\n泷垂川：虎口山脉的河川地点，可见河道、山地和沿水通路。通行与货运情况依实际行程呈现。\n\n集散中心：虎口山脉的货物中转场，矿材、工具与补给在此分拣装运，往来的车轮在地面压出深浅不一的辙痕。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-6","name":"无明湾","type":"ocean","iconType":"ocean","parentName":"","x":226,"y":52,"brief":"今州的海湾与岩壑区域，地图标有荒弃岩壑、无存残所、弦月礁和漱石原。岸线、崖壁及局部通路按当前地点呈现，名称不用于推定固定的气候成因。","地点资料":"荒弃岩壑：无明湾的岩壑地点，破碎岩坡与谷地构成环境。残象种类和临时营地分别依现场确定。\n\n无存残所：无明湾的地图地点。残存遗迹与周围地形提供探索场景；古籍、日记和人物传说需在实际调查获得后才能作为已知信息。\n\n弦月礁：无明湾一带弯如月牙的礁群，退潮后显露狭窄落脚处，浪声在礁缝间往复，夜色下不易辨认安全水线。\n\n漱石原：近海的砾石原野，海风将草木压得低矮，雨水沿岩面汇成细流，冲刷出颜色清浅的石纹。","detailMap":"","aliases":["无名湾"]},{"id":"jinzhou-7","name":"归墟港市","type":"port","iconType":"port","parentName":"","x":22,"y":84,"brief":"今州境内的旧港市与遗迹区域，包含东麓研究站、落定岭、潮音海丘、焚焰海等地图地点。与异常频率相关的调查通向黑海岸故事；遗迹环境与主线中的特殊现象分别描写。","地点资料":"东麓研究站：归墟港市相关的研究设施地点。研究人员、设备状态与调查任务按当时情境交代，不预设守岸人在此轮换驻守。\n\n落定岭：归墟港市的岭地地点，沿途岩坡与港市遗迹相接。附近人员、营地和危险程度按实际经过确定。\n\n潮音海丘：归墟港市的海岸丘地，海面、岸线与旧港遗迹共同构成景观。潮汐和特殊频率作用不混为固定的重力翻转机制。\n\n焚焰海：归墟港市的重要地图区域，与旧港遗存及异常环境有关。主线揭示的特殊频率另按证据处理，不预设噬亡星残响一直封存在此或黑海岸统一管制所有通路。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-8","name":"无光之森","type":"forest","iconType":"forest","parentName":"","x":146,"y":154,"brief":"今州境内的森林区域，地图标有紫月榕、中央巨榕、闻野滩、丛棘步道和猢思崖。林区环境与残象活动按所在位置描写，不另设一套名为“孢子型悲鸣”的固定分类。","地点资料":"猢思崖：无光之森的崖地地点。崖边、林缘和落差构成行进环境，不预置一座登记、检查和换装都必须经过的科考营地。\n\n紫月榕：无光之森的地图地点。树木、藤蔓和林下光影可用于描写林区环境，不由地名直接推定孢子会干扰所有仪器。\n\n中央巨榕：无光之森的巨树地标，树干、根系与林间空间构成显著景观。树穴内的遭遇及其历史分别依任务和现场交付。\n\n闻野滩：无光之森的滩地地点，岸边植被与林区环境相连。生物、残象与采样活动按本次场景确认。\n\n丛棘步道：无光之森的林间道路，荆棘与植被影响视野和行进。是否能通向相邻地区及所需路程按实际路线判断。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-9","name":"怨鸟泽","type":"swamp","iconType":"swamp","parentName":"","x":256,"y":154,"brief":"今州的湿地与遗址区域，地图标有羽鹭湿地、觉林峡、稷廷遗址、鲧巢港等地点。调查遗址与前往港口是不同的行程，具体异常和敌人按任务与现场确定。","地点资料":"觉林峡：怨鸟泽的溪谷地点，水流、崖壁与林地共同构成环境。附近生物与残象分别采用已有资料，不指定一套未确认的常驻物种。\n\n羽鹭湿地：怨鸟泽的湿地区域，水塘、苇草与湿地通路构成地形。局部异常、敌人和可通行范围由现场确认。\n\n稷廷遗址：怨鸟泽的稷廷遗迹，是相关主线调查记录与异常线索的场所。进入的区域、可取得的资料及地下战斗按当时事件展开。\n\n鲧巢港：怨鸟泽内的独立探索地点，实地收集路线将其与羽鹭湿地、觉林峡分开记录。这里只确认地点归属，不把它与祈池村或今州港口合并。\n\n塬上旧址：怨鸟泽内的独立探索地点，实地收集路线将其与羽鹭湿地、觉林峡分开记录。这里只确认地点归属，不把它与祈池村或今州港口合并。\n\n龙山渡：怨鸟泽水道旁的旧渡口，木桩与石岸间系着渡索。湿雾浓时，对岸只剩模糊的山影与零星灯火。\n\n呜呜仓储站：怨鸟泽内的独立探索地点，实地收集路线将其与羽鹭湿地、觉林峡分开记录。这里只确认地点归属，不把它与祈池村或今州港口合并。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-10","name":"乘霄山","type":"mountainisland","iconType":"mountainisland","parentName":"","x":528,"y":192,"brief":"今州相关主线中的山地秘地，虹镇、隙光滩、璇玑岭、卧龙冈等地点分布其间。岁主角的时序之能影响区域时流；长离关于山中一天与外界十天的说法是解释时间差的设例，不作为所有时段与所有人物通用的固定倍率。","地点资料":"虹镇：乘霄山中的聚落，是本线拜访居民、休整和了解山中情况的重要地点。镇内设施、居民态度与时流影响随当前剧情状态呈现。\n\n天取木：乘霄山的巨木地标，树干、枝叶与山地景观构成场景。树下是否存在密室、档案或特殊频率设施，需要有实际调查依据。\n\n隙光滩：乘霄山沿岸的细窄滩地，晨光穿过山石缝隙落在浅水上，光带随潮汐移动，礁后藏着避风的小片沙地。\n\n璇玑岭：乘霄山的山岭地点，相关任务会在山中道路与机关间展开。撷光锁、溯流仪及叩天关等对象依实际位置分别处理。\n\n游龙脊：乘霄山蜿蜒起伏的长脊，山径沿背风处盘行，云雾掠过时，远处峰线仿佛游龙隐入天际。\n\n卧龙冈：乘霄山中的山地地点。前往眠龙庭及岁主相关场所的路线按当前任务确认，区域名称不直接等同于庭院内部。\n\n盘龙崖：乘霄山临海的陡崖，岩层盘绕如鳞，崖间旧道狭窄，越靠近风口，越能听见海浪自下方传来的轰鸣。\n\n眠龙庭：乘霄山主线中的场所，与岁主角及当前时序事件相关。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"jinzhou-11","name":"黑海岸","type":"archipelago","iconType":"archipelago","parentName":"","x":608,"y":11,"brief":"面向索拉里斯开展悲鸣观测、研究和协作的组织驻地，建立在巨大的黑石之上。地表设施与地下泰缇斯之底分别处理；黑石会干扰普通终端通信，黑海岸使用专属信标。系统异常造成的数据与现实变化以当前主线状态为准。","地点资料":"移转异象所：黑海岸地表的设施地点，与当地的研究和异常调查相关。具体设备、收容对象及开放区域由当前任务交付。\n\n泰缇斯枢纽：黑海岸群岛地表的设施区。黑海岸承担悲鸣观测、预警与各地协作；真正的核心工作区则位于地下的泰缇斯之底。地表设施与地下机密区应分开描写。\n\n新枝地：黑海岸群岛地表的地点。组织将新加入者称作“新枝”，并以入门手册介绍群岛职能、残响采集及悲鸣预警工作；来访者仍需组织邀请与引导。","detailMap":"tethys","aliases":["黑海岸群岛"],"region":"黑海岸群岛"},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-12","name":"移转异象所","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"黑海岸","x":612,"y":-30,"brief":"黑海岸地表的设施地点，与当地的研究和异常调查相关。具体设备、收容对象及开放区域由当前任务交付。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[],"region":"黑海岸群岛"},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-13","name":"泰缇斯枢纽","type":"scene","iconType":"facility","parentName":"黑海岸","x":616,"y":13,"brief":"黑海岸群岛地表的设施区。黑海岸承担悲鸣观测、预警与各地协作；真正的核心工作区则位于地下的泰缇斯之底。地表设施与地下机密区应分开描写。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[],"region":"黑海岸群岛"},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-14","name":"新枝地","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"黑海岸","x":587,"y":6,"brief":"黑海岸群岛地表的地点。组织将新加入者称作“新枝”，并以入门手册介绍群岛职能、残响采集及悲鸣预警工作；来访者仍需组织邀请与引导。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[],"region":"黑海岸群岛"},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-15","name":"鸣钟涧","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"云陵谷","x":-8,"y":-34,"brief":"云陵谷内的地图地点，与云陵谷整体分别标记。本卡《万象新声》开场落点不固定在这里。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-16","name":"玉龙台","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"云陵谷","x":22,"y":-53,"brief":"云陵谷的小区域，也是《万象新声》初期探索路线涉及的地点。可用于表现漂泊者初到今州时的山野探索，不将其写成另一座城市。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-17","name":"夜明坡","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"云陵谷","x":17,"y":-66,"brief":"云陵谷的小区域，与鸣钟涧、玉龙台共同组成游戏开篇的探索地带。它是野外地点，和今州城内街区分开。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-18","name":"今州城界","type":"scene","iconType":"city","parentName":"今州","x":136,"y":-12,"brief":"库街区地图对今州主城的地点标注。本卡将“今州”“今州城”“今州城界”作为同一主城范围的定位用语，不另造一座同名城池。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-19","name":"倚湖丘","type":"scene","iconType":"lake","parentName":"今州","x":131,"y":23,"brief":"临近今州湖岸的缓丘，草坡与石阶交错，是居民散步、旅人入城前整理行装的歇脚处。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-20","name":"屏庭山","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"今州","x":184,"y":13,"brief":"今州城的后山。任务全文中，秧秧说明可从今州城广场后的瀑布穿过去，沿花朵指引前往山中寻找维里奈。具体行进方向按当前路线描述。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":["屛庭山"]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-21","name":"萤泊海","type":"scene","iconType":"lake","parentName":"中曲台地","x":57,"y":36,"brief":"水草繁密的浅水地，暮色中细小荧光沿水面浮动，远望如星屑泊入湖海，夜行时容易误判岸线。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-22","name":"撷华庄","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"中曲台地","x":35,"y":2,"brief":"今州近郊、中曲台地探索路线中的地点，周围分布可捕鱼的池塘。适合描写城郊水域与野外行走，不能据地名认定为某个角色的私人庄园。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-23","name":"龙望郊","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"中曲台地","x":89,"y":-11,"brief":"今州主城附近的郊野地点，中曲台地探索路线涉及此处，附近可见池塘水域。它和主城、撷华庄分别标注。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-24","name":"叠石坪","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"中曲台地","x":49,"y":-47,"brief":"层层裸岩铺成的开阔台地，石缝间长着矮草。旧路在此分岔，风化石堆常被旅人当作辨路标记。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-25","name":"桃源乡","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"中曲台地","x":79,"y":-60,"brief":"中曲台地的聚落地点，村落、道路和周边林地分别构成当地场景。居民处境与沿途遭遇依实际行程展开。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-26","name":"祈池村","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"中曲台地","x":125,"y":-76,"brief":"中曲台地的村落，是今州早期主线调查涉及的地点。已有剧情文本明确其所在区域；不沿用旧资料将其并入怨鸟泽的说法。村落现状随当前章节呈现。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-27","name":"谷北地","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"中曲台地","x":79,"y":-90,"brief":"中曲台地北侧的地图地点。实地收集路线将它与桃源乡一并探索，但两者各有地名，应保留为两个节点。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-28","name":"潮生崖","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"中曲台地","x":178,"y":-72,"brief":"中曲台地的临水崖地，可从崖壁、岸线和沿途观景点描写环境。景观不预设某些敌人或宝藏必然在场。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-29","name":"原点科考站","type":"scene","iconType":"laboratory","parentName":"中曲台地","x":266,"y":-27,"brief":"中曲台地的科考设施地点，科研活动、人员与设备状态依现场和任务呈现。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-30","name":"远望营地","type":"scene","iconType":"camp","parentName []},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-59","name":"隙光滩","type":"scene","iconType":"ocean","parentName":"乘霄山","x":444,"y":163,"brief":"乘霄山沿岸的细窄滩地，晨光穿过山石缝隙落在浅水上，光带随潮汐移动，礁后藏着避风的小片沙地。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-60","name":"璇玑岭","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"乘霄山","x":471,"y":206,"brief":"乘霄山的山岭地点，相关任务会在山中道路与机关间展开。撷光锁、溯流仪及叩天关等对象依实际位置分别处理。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-61","name":"虹镇","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"乘霄山","x":509,"y":192,"brief":"乘霄山中的聚落，是本线拜访居民、休整和了解山中情况的重要地点。镇内设施、居民态度与时流影响随当前剧情状态呈现。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-62","name":"天取木","type":"scene","iconType":"tree","parentName":"乘霄山","x":538,"y":212,"brief":"乘霄山的巨木地标，树干、枝叶与山地景观构成场景。树下是否存在密室、档案或特殊频率设施，需要有实际调查依据。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-63","name":"游龙脊","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"乘霄山","x":544,"y":236,"brief":"乘霄山蜿蜒起伏的长脊，山径沿背风处盘行，云雾掠过时，远处峰线仿佛游龙隐入天际。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-64","name":"卧龙冈","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"乘霄山","x":531,"y":176,"brief":"乘霄山中的山地地点。前往眠龙庭及岁主相关场所的路线按当前任务确认，区域名称不直接等同于庭院内部。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-jinzhou-65","name":"盘龙崖","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"乘霄山","x":571,"y":190,"brief":"乘霄山临海的陡崖，岩层盘绕如鳞，崖间旧道狭窄，越靠近风口，越能听见海浪自下方传来的轰鸣。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-0","name":"黎乔利群岛","type":"archipelago","iconType":"archipelago","parentName":"","x":-272,"y":572,"brief":"拉古那相关的海岛区域，地图标有黎乔利港、舵盘村、沉静湾、莱耶斯遗迹群和德雷克岛。《老人鱼海》中，航海、风暴、海妖与溯海之鲸的调查在这些海域展开，港村生活与古老遗迹分别呈现。","地点资料":"黎乔利港：黎乔利群岛的港口地点，是航海活动与当地人员往来的场景。码头事务由实际在场角色承担，不凭旧介绍预设管理者身份。\n\n舵盘村：黎乔利群岛的村落地点，与当地航海和渔业生活相关。村民态度、习俗与知识边界分别由交流呈现。\n\n沉静湾：黎乔利群岛的海湾地点，与《老人鱼海》的海域调查相关。巨鲸行踪和海况依实际航程变化，不设必须先被鲸认可才能进入的固定门槛。\n\n德雷克岛：黎乔利群岛的岛屿地点。遗迹、居民和来访者的情况按现场呈现，未取得的历史材料不直接作为角色知识。\n\n莱耶斯遗迹群：《老人鱼海》中与风暴、海妖和溯海之鲸调查相关的岛屿遗迹。亚哈说明风暴阻拦登岛，后续通过实际行动寻找解法；不把未取得的古代记录当作已公开信息。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-1","name":"悲叹墓岛","type":"island","iconType":"island","parentName":"","x":-63,"y":738,"brief":"海雾与暗流包围的岛屿，是隐海修会流放朝圣者的目的地，也与愚人剧团及叹息古龙相关。图上包括船首祭地、嗟叹长阶、船葬滩和补充的剧团、海墟地点；赞悼圣迹为另一个区域，不归入墓岛内部。","地点资料":"船首祭地：悲叹墓岛的地图地点，与岛屿旧日巡礼背景和沿岸遗迹相关。登陆点、船只与当前雾况按实际航行确认。\n\n嗟叹长阶：悲叹墓岛上的阶梯与巡礼相关地点，沿途可见遗迹与回音云带来的环境变化。实际通路和危险按现场呈现。\n\n愚人乐土：悲叹墓岛中与愚人剧团相关的活动区域，设有剧团舞台，成员在此排演、休息。具体人物是否出现，以当前任务与故事时点为准。\n\n船葬滩：悲叹墓岛的海滩，洋流使船骸搁浅，滩上的残破船体构成显著景观，与墓岛的海难、流放背景相连。\n\n愚人海窟：愚人剧团活动相关的洞窟地点，任务中会前往此处与布兰特交谈。本卡将其作为愚人乐土相关的洞窟节点分别展示，不据图上位置推算两者的距离。\n\n冥歌海墟：船葬滩附近的海上残墟，海雾与远处歌声构成醒目标志；迷雾中的声音会诱使船员驶向危险海域。接近条件与玩法开启不因查图自动满足。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-2","name":"槲生半岛","type":"island","iconType":"island","parentName":"","x":120,"y":760,"brief":"黎那汐塔拉古那相关区域，地图标有青栎庭院、蒙召海和残息海岸。修会往事、地方生活及沿途调查依所在地点与已取得的信息呈现。","地点资料":"青栎庭院：槲生半岛的庭院地点，有树木露台、上下层空间及溢彩画探索点。保留庭院与半岛的层级，不将某一层的画点当作整座庭院。\n\n蒙召海：槲生半岛近旁的海面，薄雾时聚时散，远航者常以岸上树影辨认方向；关于海上呼声的传闻在当地流传。\n\n残息海岸：槲生半岛风浪侵蚀的岸段，碎木与旧石构散落潮线上，海水退去后，岩洞中仍回荡着断续潮声。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-3","name":"拂风水畔","type":"lake","iconType":"lake","parentName":"","x":-220,"y":790,"brief":"拉古那城郊的开阔高地，分布着独特的风车。埃格拉镇与白月林迹属于这一带的探索地点，城外景观和水城街区明显不同。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-4","name":"赞悼圣迹","type":"poi","iconType":"poi","parentName":"","x":-30,"y":784,"brief":"拉古那辖地中的一片遗迹区域。其探索报告以关于旧拉古那沉没与离乡的古歌剧记录呈现历史，可据遗迹和文献逐渐引出旧日记忆。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-5","name":"拉古那","type":"city","iconType":"city","parentName":"","x":-277,"y":813,"brief":"黎那汐塔的水上城邦，贡多拉穿行于水道，狂欢节、家族活动与公共声骸构成当地生活的重要部分。隐海修会宣称代行岁主英白拉多的意志；神谕、信仰争议及黑潮影响按当时章节的信息与结果交付。","地点资料":"莫塔里区：拉古那与莫塔里家族相关的城区，家族往来、商贸与居民生活在此交织。具体建筑和活动依当前访问呈现。\n\n广场区：拉古那人来往聚集的开阔街区，石铺广场连着水巷，白日可见摊贩与街头表演，节庆时常挂起彩带。\n\n银行街：拉古那交易往来密集的街道，账房与商铺门面相邻，递送契据的信使穿行其间，谈生意的人常在廊下低声交涉。\n\n隐海修会：拉古那的重要宗教组织，宣称代行岁主英白拉多的意志。地图以同名节点标记其所在区域；组织、建筑区域与具体教士应分别描述。","detailMap":"","aliases":["拉古那城"]},{"id":"ragunna-6","name":"氤柔水境","type":"otherspace","iconType":"otherspace","parentName":"","x":-34,"y":854,"brief":"与云海及回音生物相关的区域，地图标有白雾堤、泊金港和咏夜歌庭。罗蕾莱与云海净化、控制有关；云海受到污染及其向城邦扩散的风险，应按当时调查所得和剧情状态判断。","地点资料":"白雾堤：氤柔水境的堤岸地点，水雾、岸边通路与登舟场景构成环境。进入云海不自动附加必然迷失或致幻的通用效果。\n\n咏夜歌庭：氤柔水境的庭院地点，与罗蕾莱及云海相关主线有关。歌声、净化能力与污染状态按当时调查逐步交付。\n\n泊金港：氤柔水境的港口地点。码头与水上交通分别按现场呈现，不预设存在逆瀑直通金库的秘密运输线。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-7","name":"埃弗拉德金库","type":"bank","iconType":"bank","parentName":"","x":141,"y":865,"brief":"莫塔里家族相关的金库与馆藏区域。拉古那城内的埃弗拉德银行与金库本体分别处理，下层金库内设藏馆与声骸站台；馆藏区域之间可见声骸列车交通。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"vault","aliases":[]},{"id":"ragunna-8","name":"狄萨莱海脊","type":"ocean","iconType":"ocean","parentName":"","x":-98,"y":899,"brief":"与翡萨烈家族及修会往事有关的拉古那地区。地图标有双子峪、三重冠塔、波蒂维诺堡和失乐园，人物接触、家族权限与进入遗址的路线由当前事件确定。","地点资料":"双子峪：狄萨莱海脊的峡谷地点，山崖与通路形成行进空间。是否设有哨卫及来客权限按当时事件确定。\n\n三重冠塔：狄萨莱海脊的塔楼遗迹地点。塔楼的外观、内部构造及遗存用途可通过现场与资料逐步了解。\n\n波蒂维诺堡：与翡萨烈家族及坎特蕾拉相关的宅邸地点。赴约、家族交涉和相关回忆依翡萨烈家族这条事件线展开。\n\n失乐园：狄萨莱海脊一带的独立地点。地名不等于另一处独立索诺拉，也不能据名推定其宗教含义；具体环境沿用当前现场与任务记录。","detailMap":"hiddenlab","aliases":["狄萨莱海湾","狄萨莱海岭"]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-9","name":"广场区","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"拉古那","x":-307,"y":810,"brief":"拉古那人来往聚集的开阔街区，石铺广场连着水巷，白日可见摊贩与街头表演，节庆时常挂起彩带。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-10","name":"银行街","type":"scene","iconType":"bank","parentName":"拉古那","x":-301,"y":823,"brief":"拉古那交易往来密集的街道，账房与商铺门面相邻，递送契据的信使穿行其间，谈生意的人常在廊下低声交涉。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-11","name":"隐海修会","type":"scene","iconType":"temple","parentName":"拉古那","x":-258,"y":821,"brief":"拉古那的重要宗教组织，宣称代行岁主英白拉多的意志。地图以同名节点标记其所在区域；组织、建筑区域与具体教士应分别描述。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-12","name":"莫塔里区","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"拉古那","x":-296,"y":799,"brief":"拉古那与莫塔里家族相关的城区，家族往来、商贸与居民生活在此交织。具体建筑和活动依当前访问呈现。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-13","name":"船首祭地","type":"scene","iconType":"temple","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":-51,"y":718,"brief":"悲叹墓岛的地图地点，与岛屿旧日巡礼背景和沿岸遗迹相关。登陆点、船只与当前雾况按实际航行确认。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-14","name":"嗟叹长阶","type":"scene","iconType":"bridge","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":-28,"y":762,"brief":"悲叹墓岛上的阶梯与巡礼相关地点，沿途可见遗迹与回音云带来的环境变化。实际通路和危险按现场呈现。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-15","name":"船葬滩","type":"scene","iconType":"ocean","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":32,"y":709,"brief":"悲叹墓岛的海滩，洋流使船骸搁浅，滩上的残破船体构成显著景观，与墓岛的海难、流放背景相连。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-16","name":"遗颂河谷","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"赞悼圣迹","x":-30,"y":798,"brief":"赞悼圣迹旁的河谷，流水绕过断柱和残阶，风穿旧拱时带出绵长回声，令人想起早已失传的颂歌。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-17","name":"白月林迹","type":"scene","iconType":"forest","parentName":"拂风水畔","x":-223,"y":738,"brief":"拂风水畔尽头岛屿上的树林遗迹，林木与遗构围绕中央湖泊构成迷宫，和骑士传闻及往昔幻影有关。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-18","name":"独眼风车群","type":"scene","iconType":"windmill","parentName":"拂风水畔","x":-159,"y":797,"brief":"拂风水畔的风车地点，探索路线与溢彩画点位均单独标记此处。可将风车作为辨认郊野方向的地标。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-19","name":"埃格拉镇","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"拂风水畔","x":-139,"y":854,"brief":"拂风水畔一带的古朴小镇，定居历史悠久，白天安静，夜里可见游荡声骸的热闹景象。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-20","name":"泊金港","type":"scene","iconType":"port","parentName":"氤柔水境","x":43,"y":824,"brief":"氤柔水境的港口地点。码头与水上交通分别按现场呈现，不预设存在逆瀑直通金库的秘密运输线。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-21","name":"咏夜歌庭","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"氤柔水境","x":-29,"y":845,"brief":"氤柔水境的庭院地点，与罗蕾莱及云海相关主线有关。歌声、净化能力与污染状态按当时调查逐步交付。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-22","name":"白雾堤","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"氤柔水境","x":-144,"y":826,"brief":"氤柔水境的堤岸地点，水雾、岸边通路与登舟场景构成环境。进入云海不自动附加必然迷失或致幻的通用效果。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-23","name":"青栎庭院","type":"scene","iconType":"garden","parentName":"槲生半岛","x":115,"y":778,"brief":"槲生半岛的庭院地点，有树木露台、上下层空间及溢彩画探索点。保留庭院与半岛的层级，不将某一层的画点当作整座庭院。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id 亚哈说明风暴阻拦登岛，后续通过实际行动寻找解法；不把未取得的古代记录当作已公开信息。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-ragunna-34","name":"德雷克岛","type":"scene","iconType":"island","parentName":"黎乔利群岛","x":-343,"y":685,"brief":"黎乔利群岛的岛屿地点。遗迹、居民和来访者的情况按现场呈现，未取得的历史材料不直接作为角色知识。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"grave-added-35","name":"愚人乐土","type":"scene","iconType":"camp","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":-105,"y":727,"brief":"悲叹墓岛中与愚人剧团相关的活动区域，设有剧团舞台，成员在此排演、休息。具体人物是否出现，以当前任务与故事时点为准。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":["愚人乐土（剧团溶洞）"]},{"id":"grave-added-36","name":"愚人海窟","type":"scene","iconType":"dungeon","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":-86,"y":749,"brief":"愚人剧团活动相关的洞窟地点，任务中会前往此处与布兰特交谈。本卡将其作为愚人乐土相关的洞窟节点分别展示，不据图上位置推算两者的距离。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":["剧团溶洞"]},{"id":"grave-added-37","name":"冥歌海墟","type":"scene","iconType":"ruins","parentName":"悲叹墓岛","x":68,"y":701,"brief":"船葬滩附近的海上残墟，海雾与远处歌声构成醒目标志；迷雾中的声音会诱使船员驶向危险海域。接近条件与玩法开启不因查图自动满足。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"septimont-0","name":"贝奥海域","type":"ocean","iconType":"ocean","parentName":"","x":-98,"y":1034,"brief":"与阿维纽林地上旧址相关的海域，地图标有贝奥海沟及地上旧址。进入神学院遗址的具体路线按当前任务确认，不把某个地点写成适用于所有剧情的唯一入口。","地点资料":"贝奥海沟：贝奥海域深处的狭长海沟，水色越向下越晦暗，断裂岩壁遮住视线，勘察者通常借照明与绳索维持联系。\n\n阿维纽林 · 地上旧址：贝奥海域的阿维纽林旧址节点。神学院本体如今倒悬在云海中，地上旧址和空中的学院分开定位；本卡可由此打开阿维纽林独立地图。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"septimont-1","name":"七丘","type":"city","iconType":"city","parentName":"","x":107,"y":1481,"brief":"黎那汐塔的城邦，与声骸角斗及对抗黑潮的行猎活动密切相关。卡庇托山城区举办四年一届的大角斗赛；总督、元老院和谕女有各自的职责与立场，不能只按名称推定其全部权限。","地点资料":"卡庇托山城：全文中出现的地点或设施，具体用途以当前任务为准。\n\n卡庇托山山麓：全文中出现的地点或设施，具体用途以当前任务为准。\n\n巨石原：七丘的原野地点，与前往卡庇托山的行程相关。地表景观、英灵古道与沿路活动分别按实际路线描写。\n\n英灵古道：全文中出现的地点或设施，具体用途以当前任务为准。\n\n分界山：七丘的山地地点，山路、洞穴与沿途遗迹分别构成探索环境。具体试炼、守卫和历史沿革按实际资料交付。\n\n哀恸谷：七丘的谷地地点，与黑潮相关事件和探索有关。谷地地形与遗存可通过沿途调查逐渐了解。\n\n卡庇托山：七丘的城区地点，大角斗赛及相关城市活动在此展开。奥利多斯大竞技场与列奥尼达酒店是不同的场所，分别承接赛事与旅客休憩。\n\n弥诺斯地下水道：七丘的地下探索空间，包含分支通道、门与任务探索区域。地下路线需按实际入口与开启状态行进，不能从地表图上的邻近位置直接穿墙抵达。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"septimont-2","name":"桑古伊斯狩原","type":"plains","iconType":"plains","parentName":"","x":98,"y":1643,"brief":"七丘的猎场区域，上方有持续不散的黑潮云。涨潮期到来时，七丘战士与角斗士会进行巡狩、剿杀残象；参战者、黑潮状态及行动结果以该次主线实际经过为准。","地点资料":"阿提留斯隘口：桑古伊斯狩原的隘口地点，与进入猎场的行程相关。军团、补给、坐骑和观测设备是否在场按本次行动确认。\n\n狩猎者营地：桑古伊斯狩原繁忙的角斗士驻地，猎人出征前常经由此处前往猎场，狩猎队也在这里休整。它是前线驻地，不等同于四方殿的宗教空间。\n\n赤林猎场：桑古伊斯狩原的猎场地点。巡狩行动与残象活动受当时黑潮状态影响，不将所有遭遇固定成安全的新兵试炼。\n\n锈岩脊：桑古伊斯狩原的岩脊通路，主线追猎途中需穿越。落石、地面塌陷与熔石攻击会影响通行，岩柱和岩脊可提供掩护；危险随实际狩猎阶段变化。\n\n往世花平野：桑古伊斯狩原的花原地点。花海与旧日痕迹可构成景观，是否出现残响、其含义和影响需由当时事件确认。\n\n三王峰：桑古伊斯狩原的山峰地点。山峰的命名来源和历史人物关系需通过文献或剧情线索了解。\n\n彻地之楔：桑古伊斯狩原的地图地点，与黑潮及巡狩相关事件有关。具体敌人的名称、危险度和本次战斗目标按主线及既有资料确定。\n\n四方殿：桑古伊斯狩原的殿宇地点，存在多层地下空间，实地路线可见楼梯、石柱、门与狮鹫石像。上下层应分开叙述。\n\n受蚀地：桑古伊斯狩原受黑潮影响的地图地点，与呓语镇等区域分别标记。侵蚀程度和沿途威胁以本次调查为准。\n\n呓语镇：桑古伊斯狩原中与追猎、异常声响调查相关的地点。主线经过狩原后继续在此调查；异常来源应由现场线索揭露。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-3","name":"贝奥海沟","type":"scene","iconType":"dungeon","parentName":"贝奥海域","x":-278,"y":1124,"brief":"贝奥海域深处的狭长海沟，水色越向下越晦暗，断裂岩壁遮住视线，勘察者通常借照明与绳索维持联系。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-4","name":"阿维纽林 ,"x":100,"y":1648,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原的岩脊通路，主线追猎途中需穿越。落石、地面塌陷与熔石攻击会影响通行，岩柱和岩脊可提供掩护；危险随实际狩猎阶段变化。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-14","name":"赤林猎场","type":"scene","iconType":"forest","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":77,"y":1677,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原的猎场地点。巡狩行动与残象活动受当时黑潮状态影响，不将所有遭遇固定成安全的新兵试炼。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-15","name":"往世花平野","type":"scene","iconType":"garden","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":35,"y":1688,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原的花原地点。花海与旧日痕迹可构成景观，是否出现残响、其含义和影响需由当时事件确认。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-16","name":"受蚀地","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":118,"y":1663,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原受黑潮影响的地图地点，与呓语镇等区域分别标记。侵蚀程度和沿途威胁以本次调查为准。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-17","name":"呓语镇","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":149,"y":1650,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原中与追猎、异常声响调查相关的地点。主线经过狩原后继续在此调查；异常来源应由现场线索揭露。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-18","name":"彻地之楔","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":204,"y":1649,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原的地图地点，与黑潮及巡狩相关事件有关。具体敌人的名称、危险度和本次战斗目标按主线及既有资料确定。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-septimont-19","name":"三王峰","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"桑古伊斯狩原","x":-29,"y":1682,"brief":"桑古伊斯狩原的山峰地点。山峰的命名来源和历史人物关系需通过文献或剧情线索了解。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"xuanfang-0","name":"玄方城","type":"city","iconType":"city","parentName":"","x":-643,"y":-51,"brief":"与今州接壤的玄方地界核心城池，建造者为梦州岁主心月狐“心”。定玄卫、机傀与咎庭承担不同的防卫和残象处理职责；异常机傀、封城与失联调查由主线展开。巡霄环可用于追踪过去残留的相关记录，权限和使用条件以实际交付为准。","地点资料":"玄方·天工部：玄方城负责机关维护与修造的工务院落，拆开的机件与检修台沿廊排布，值班匠人靠敲击声判断零件磨损。\n\n玄方·军策府：玄方地界的军务机构，所属武装为定玄卫。此地图节点用于区分军务办事处与整座机关城。\n\n汇珍坊：玄方城的商贸坊市，器物、布料与地方小食混杂陈列，摊主各有吆喝，旅人常在这里询价或交换路上见闻。\n\n玄方·华胥院：玄方城接诊伤病、照料疲惫行旅的院舍，内庭清静，药香从半掩的窗中散出，来客需先在廊前登记。\n\n匣林苑：玄方城中设有机关景物的园苑，小径绕过树木与层叠匣架，静歇时能听见细微的齿轮转动声。\n\n玄方广场：玄方城内连接主要街巷的公共场地，告示、交接与日常集会在此进行，机关城换防时，广场周边的通行会暂缓。\n\n西擎坡：玄方城西侧的坡地，货道沿坡抬升，可望见远处工构；雨后石面湿滑，运货人会放慢脚步。\n\n东幽隘：玄方城东侧较为幽深的隘道，崖壁收窄了视野，雾气易在低处停留，行人常以路旁的标记确认去向。","detailMap":"dreamcore","aliases":[]},{"id":"xuanfang-1","name":"玄幽东岳","type":"mountain","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"","x":-510,"y":-5,"brief":"玄方地界的东侧山域，地图标有寂渊旧墟、倚枝岭、雾隐阁和衔翎村。隐息雾与搜寻、调查有关，其正常作用和异常状态按现场分别呈现，不另造机关术流派名。","地点资料":"雾隐阁：玄幽东岳的机关设施地点，与隐息雾及相关调查有关。雾的正常作用、异常状态和机关通路按现场确认，不预设清宵长期以此为道馆。\n\n寂渊旧墟：玄幽东岳一带的旧构遗址，残墙被藤根分割，低处积着薄雾，零散石刻只剩难以连读的字句。\n\n倚枝岭：玄幽东岳林木覆盖的山岭，弯曲枝干探向山径，树根牵住崖边薄土，偶见可供短暂停歇的避风岩台。\n\n衔翎村：玄方地界的村落，保留玄翎古谣等地方文化。游记记载过村中集会与古谣演唱，可表现村民对玄翎的集体记忆。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"xuanfang-2","name":"方擎西峰","type":"mountain","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"","x":-812,"y":34,"brief":"玄方地界的西峰区域。木禺在主线中说明，这里设有玄方地界最大的机傀生产工厂，以及残象销毁炉悬天构。机傀生产、巡防异常与残象处理分别按事件推进。","地点资料":"千形坊·流线：悬天构内的千形坊分区。千形坊以流水线工坊制造机傀，为玄方的防御与换防提供机关支援；各分区按地图分别定位。\n\n千形坊·构间：千形坊内的机关拼装分区，与机傀制造流程相关。它属于悬天构的工厂体系，不是玄方城的居民街坊。\n\n千形坊·湮墟：千形坊边缘封存的旧工区，废弃机架与断裂输送构件相互叠压，仍能从排列中看出过去流水作业的轮廓。\n\n悬天构：主线明确的机傀生产工厂与残象销毁炉所在设施，具体进出和当前状态以事件为准。","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"xuanfang-3","name":"落渊南丘","type":"plains","iconType":"plains","parentName":"","x":-656,"y":89,"brief":"玄方地界南部区域，南面的山门连着梦窟，穿越后可抵今州地界。井栈是这一带的重要入城驿站。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-4","name":"玄方·天工部","type":"scene","iconType":"workshop","parentName":"玄方城","x":-645,"y":-80,"brief":"玄方城负责机关维护与修造的工务院落，拆开的机件与检修台沿廊排布，值班匠人靠敲击声判断零件磨损。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-5","name":"玄方·军策府","type":"scene","iconType":"stronghold","parentName":"玄方城","x":-618,"y":-66,"brief":"玄方地界的军务机构，所属武装为定玄卫。此地图节点用于区分军务办事处与整座机关城。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-6","name":"汇珍坊","type":"scene","iconType":"shop","parentName":"玄方城","x":-619,"y":-40,"brief":"玄方城的商贸坊市，器物、布料与地方小食混杂陈列，摊主各有吆喝，旅人常在这里询价或交换路上见闻。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-7","name":"玄方·华胥院","type":"scene","iconType":"medical","parentName":"玄方城","x":-663,"y":-36,"brief":"玄方城接诊伤病、照料疲惫行旅的院舍，内庭清静，药香从半掩的窗中散出，来客需先在廊前登记。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-8","name":"匣林苑","type":"scene","iconType":"garden","parentName":"玄方城","x":-669,"y":-62,"brief":"玄方城中设有机关景物的园苑，小径绕过树木与层叠匣架，静歇时能听见细微的齿轮转动声。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-9","name":"玄方广场","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"玄方城","x":-640,"y":-29,"brief":"玄方城内连接主要街巷的公共场地，告示、交接与日常集会在此进行，机关城换防时，广场周边的通行会暂缓。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-10","name":"西擎坡","type":"scene","iconType":"plains","parentName":"玄方城","x":-720,"y":-29,"brief":"玄方城西侧的坡地，货道沿坡抬升，可望见远处工构；雨后石面湿滑，运货人会放慢脚步。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-11","name":"东幽隘","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"玄方城","x":-560,"y":-66,"brief":"玄方城东侧较为幽深的隘道，崖壁收窄了视野，雾气易在低处停留，行人常以路旁的标记确认去向。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-12","name":"千形坊·流线","type":"scene","iconType":"workshop","parentName":"方擎西峰","x":-808,"y":7,"brief":"悬天构内的千形坊分区。千形坊以流水线工坊制造机傀，为玄方的防御与换防提供机关支援；各分区按地图分别定位。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-13","name":"千形坊·构间","type":"scene","iconType":"workshop","parentName":"方擎西峰","x":-908,"y":54,"brief":"千形坊内的机关拼装分区，与机傀制造流程相关。它属于悬天构的工厂体系，不是玄方城的居民街坊。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-14","name":"千形坊·湮墟","type":"scene","iconType":"workshop","parentName":"方擎西峰","x":-817,"y":102,"brief":"千形坊边缘封存的旧工区，废弃机架与断裂输送构件相互叠压，仍能从排列中看出过去流水作业的轮廓。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-15","name":"玄方界门","type":"scene","iconType":"gate","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-606,"y":142,"brief":"落渊南丘通往玄方城的门关，机关门架与石制关道相接，人员和货物在门前依次停步，等待核验放行。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-16","name":"井栈","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-604,"y":110,"brief":"落渊南丘的驿站，外事府在此审查入城人员、物资和商品：监运使清点货物，巡方使核验身份并兼管治安。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-17","name":"雀回苑","type":"scene","iconType":"garden","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-608,"y":81,"brief":"落渊南丘的僻静园地，枝叶间悬着雀形饰物，村人路过时偶尔停留，讲述玄翎曾栖于此的旧传说。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-18","name":"洗羽潭","type":"scene","iconType":"lake","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-657,"y":76,"brief":"林间清潭，浅岸铺着圆石，风吹时水纹轻轻漫过苔痕；当地人将鸟雀临水梳羽的景象视作安宁的征兆。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-19","name":"鸣秋川","type":"scene","iconType":"poi","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-695,"y":94,"brief":"井栈东侧的森林，叶色四季常金，传说玄翎雀曾在此栖息。描写中应把关于玄翎的传说与角色亲眼所见分开。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-20","name":"沁喙林","type":"scene","iconType":"forest","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-685,"y":25,"brief":"落渊南丘的湿润林地，细流穿过低垂枝叶，鸟鸣在密林中忽远忽近，林下小径常被新落的叶片遮住。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-21","name":"终武方庭","type":"scene","iconType":"swords","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-612,"y":19,"brief":"落渊南丘的一处旧演练庭院，石地留着机傀行走与兵器碰撞的痕迹，空庭回声清晰，入夜后显得格外寂静。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-22","name":"百节廊","type":"scene","iconType":"bridge","parentName":"落渊南丘","x":-718,"y":54,"brief":"通向悬天构的廊道，也是其承重枢纽。当地关于毕重的旧事以评书形式流传，故事内容不可直接当作所有角色已证实的历史。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-23","name":"寂渊旧墟","type":"scene","iconType":"ruins","parentName":"玄幽东岳","x":-548,"y":-20,"brief":"玄幽东岳一带的旧构遗址，残墙被藤根分割，低处积着薄雾，零散石刻只剩难以连读的字句。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-24","name":"倚枝岭","type":"scene","iconType":"mountain","parentName":"玄幽东岳","x":-471,"y":-65,"brief":"玄幽东岳林木覆盖的山岭，弯曲枝干探向山径，树根牵住崖边薄土，偶见可供短暂停歇的避风岩台。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-25","name":"雾隐阁","type":"scene","iconType":"tower","parentName":"玄幽东岳","x":-500,"y":37,"brief":"玄幽东岳的机关设施地点，与隐息雾及相关调查有关。雾的正常作用、异常状态和机关通路按现场确认，不预设清宵长期以此为道馆。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-xuanfang-26","name":"衔翎村","type":"scene","iconType":"village","parentName":"玄幽东岳","x":-551,"y":123,"brief":"玄方地界的村落，保留玄翎古谣等地方文化。游记记载过村中集会与古谣演唱，可表现村民对玄翎的集体记忆。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"roya-0","name":"覆海原","type":"snow","iconType":"snow","parentName":"","x":246,"y":-972,"brief":"罗伊冰原地表的区域。其探索报告保留昭日者关于隧者与外来旅者的谈话记录，涉及尚被封存的信息；一般场景只呈现冰原地貌与当前能观察到的遗存。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"roya-1","name":"盲望之塌","type":"spaceship","iconType":"spaceship","parentName":"","x":208,"y":-780,"brief":"冰原上的坠落残骸区域。悲鸣引起地轴、磁极变化，近地卫星与空间站坠落，部分残骸曾成为先民的庇护之所。它是区域名称，不等同于一座仍正常在轨运行的空间站。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":["盲望之塌"]},{"id":"roya-2","name":"加拉尔冠阶","type":"poi","iconType":"poi","parentName":"","x":387,"y":-805,"brief":"冰原地表的探索区域。对应探索报告记载先行公约初遇罗伊牧者，以及罗伊人在外来科研势力间保全自身、参与合作的历史，不可将牧者写成不懂科技的落后部族。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"roya-3","name":"元林遗址","type":"ruins","iconType":"ruins","parentName":"","x":592,"y":-829,"brief":"古代罗伊人曾赖以生存的林地遗址，磁极变化后被冰封。研究人员在此发掘、研究古生态，并尝试还原远古森林。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"roya-4","name":"冰原运输港","type":"port","iconType":"port","parentName":"","x":351,"y":-636,"brief":"罗伊冰原地表的运输与科考区域。人员从不冻港登陆后，经过审查、运载电梯等设施进入科考站，物资亦沿运输系统转往地下拉海洛。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-roya-5","name":"极地科考站","type":"scene","iconType":"laboratory","parentName":"冰原运输港","x":327,"y":-660,"brief":"全称“深空联合：极地科考站”，由深空联合与罗伊人协作建设，围绕隧者巨剑开展观测、残骸数据回收、机体检测与冰封生物复苏工作，也是物资集散枢纽。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-roya-6","name":"罗伊不冻港","type":"scene","iconType":"port","parentName":"冰原运输港","x":453,"y":-677,"brief":"科考基地区域内的不冻港，是外界人员与物资进入罗伊冰原的常规门户。登陆审查后，可转入科考站道路与联运椎骨运输体系。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-roya-7","name":"近海磁暴监测区","type":"scene","iconType":"laboratory","parentName":"冰原运输港","x":441,"y":-559,"brief":"冰原运输港附近的沿海观测地，监测杆与警示标记沿岸设置，工作人员记录磁暴变化，为船只抵港提供参考。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-roya-8","name":"渐湖磁暴监测区","type":"scene","iconType":"laboratory","parentName":"加拉尔冠阶","x":493,"y":-812,"brief":"渐湖周边的观测区，仪器分设在岸边与较高的冻土上，用于对照湖面、气象和磁暴读数的变化。","地点资料":"","detailMap":"","aliases":[]},{"id":"kuro-roya-9","name":"渐湖","type":"scene","iconType":"lake","parentName":"加拉尔冠阶","x":465,"y":-931,"brief":"曾是罗伊人故地的重要淡水湖。当地盐晶温泉的暖流使湖泊在冰原环境中仍保持不冻；湖面与磁暴监测区分别定位。","地点资料":"","det
